title: TikTok: Roulette is designed to beat you

lines.text: Every roulette table is designed to beat you. Legally.
You bet on red. Sounds like fifty-fifty, right?
But an American wheel has thirty-eight pockets. Two of them are green.
So red only wins eighteen times out of thirty-eight.
That gap is the house edge: about five percent of every bet.
Bet ten dollars a thousand times, and on average you lose about five hundred twenty-six dollars.
The casino does not need luck. Just time.
So next time you sit down, remember:
